description: Conv accepts output-dtype controls but neither forward branch applies them.
trigger: A direct caller supplies constructor-level or forward-call out_dtype different from the convolution result dtype.
expected_behavior: The returned tensor honors the requested output dtype, following the neighboring LayerNorm interface.
actual_behavior: The constructor stores self.out_dtype, but forward reads neither dtype option and returns the reshaped convolution result unchanged.

verification.description: Compared the new constructor and both forward branches with LayerNorm's explicit output conversion. The whole-parent-tree Conv( search found no callers, and the task adds only the class and package export, so the demonstrated reach is the newly exposed direct-call API, not an existing model workflow.
verification.limits: No runtime dtype test was performed; external or dynamically constructed callers were not established.
